name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – § 68 – Am 108
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 68. Welcomes the five-point ‘ReArm Europe’ plan proposed by the Commission President on 4 March 2025; emphasises that the ReArm Europe title risks being misleading and too restrictive for a plan that aims to address the strengthening of European defence across all sectors and domains, which is essential for ensuring the security of our citizens; calls, to this end, for the plan to be renamed ‘Defend Europe’;
